movers.text: QB Baker Mayfield (foot) did not practice Wednesday; rookie Jalon Daniels took all first-team reps ahead of Sunday at Detroit, per Fox Sports' Greg Auman.
OTs Bernhard Raimann (concussion) and Jalen Travis (knee) ruled out for Thursday at Houston. CB Charvarius Ward (knee) also out; CB Sauce Gardner (calf) questionable.
DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring) ruled out for Thursday vs. the Colts; LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) on IR. RB Woody Marks (concussion) also ruled out.
DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) placed on IR Wednesday, out for the season. C Cade Mays (ankle) not expected to play Sunday vs. Tampa Bay, per the Detroit Free Press.

S Antoine Winfield Jr. (ankle) did not practice Wednesday, per Fox Sports' Greg Auman.

IND.text: OTs Bernhard Raimann (concussion) and Jalen Travis (knee) ruled out for Thursday at Houston. CB Charvarius Ward (knee) also out; CB Sauce Gardner (calf) questionable.

HOU.text: DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring) ruled out for Thursday vs. the Colts; LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) on IR. RB Woody Marks (concussion) also ruled out.

DET.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) placed on IR Wednesday, out for the season. C Cade Mays (ankle) not expected to play Sunday vs. Tampa Bay, per the Detroit Free Press.

NYJ.text: QB Geno Smith (ankle) was limited in Wednesday's walkthrough and said he intends to play Sunday vs. the Chargers, per ESPN's Rich Cimini. Cade Klubnik is the backup.

NO.text: OL: OT Asim Richards (knee) out multiple weeks per Kellen Moore; OT Taliese Fuaga (knee) and C Erik McCoy (biceps) listed doubtful vs. Chicago.

DAL.text: CB DaRon Bland and G Tyler Booker (both high-ankle sprains) listed out; among 7 Cowboys who did not practice Wednesday.
S Jalen Thompson (hamstring), out 7 games, designated to return from IR Wednesday.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray (grade 2 hamstring) missed Wednesday's practice, per ESPN's Kevin Seifert. Kirk Cousins started the 30-10 Week 10 win at Green Bay.
WR Jordan Addison had thumb surgery and is out; the Vikings will not place him on IR, per Kevin O'Connell.
TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist) limited and WR Jauan Jennings (calf) full in Wednesday's practice after missing time.

PHI.text: Nick Sirianni named Joe Milton the starter vs. the Steelers for a second straight game; Tanner McKee, back from injury, stays the backup. Jalen Hurts is on IR.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), out 3 games, practiced Wednesday per ESPN's Tim McManus; WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) was limited.

ARI.text: QB Gardner Minshew (elbow, IR) had UCL reconstruction surgery Monday. Carson Beck started the 34-6 Week 10 loss to the Rams.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) on IR; surgery still being evaluated. Kyle McCord started the Week 10 loss to the Colts.

BAL.text: QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) could return Week 16 vs. Cleveland, per ESPN's Dan Graziano. Jacoby Brissett has started the last two games.

BUF.text: CB Christian Benford (groin) did not practice Wednesday; S Cole Bishop (shoulder) and S Amani Hooker (knee) were limited.

KC.text: RB Kenneth Walker III (groin), who missed Week 10, did not practice Wednesday, per the Kansas City Star.

LV.text: TE Brock Bowers (ankle) did not practice Wednesday; Klint Kubiak said he doesn't need to practice this week to play Sunday vs. Denver, per The Athletic.

PIT.text: G Mason McCormick (ankle) placed on IR after the Week 10 loss to the Bengals.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR), out 5 games, was limited in his return to practice Wednesday.

TEN.text: WR Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) placed on IR and is out for the season, per Robert Saleh.
WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), out 2 games, was limited in Wednesday's practice.

DEN.text: S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle), out 4 games, was a full participant Wednesday, per the Broncos' official site.
